title: Canonical map on tensor realizations of simplicial objects
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a cocomplete simplicial category with the simplex category and simplicial sets of [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set] and chosen tensors of [def-coef-simplicial-tensor-cotensor]. Use the explicit tensor coequalizer realizations of [def-coef-simplicial-model-realization]. For a morphism $f:X_\bullet\to Y_\bullet$ of simplicial objects, define $a_f:\coprod_n\Delta^n\otimes X_n\to |Y_\bullet|$ on the $n$-th summand as $\Delta^n\otimes f_n$ followed by the summand inclusion and the target coequalizer projection. Naturality of $f$ and the tensor representing isomorphisms give $l_X;a_f=r_X;a_f$, where $l_X,r_X$ are the two recorded coend relation arrows. Define the canonical realization map $|f|:|X_\bullet|\to|Y_\bullet|$ by coequalizer descent of $a_f$ using this equality. Equivalently it is the unique arrow with the stated restrictions to all tensor summands.

source.place: A Primer on Homotopy Colimits, formula (3.2), Section 3.1, printed p.9 (coequalizer realization and its induced maps), and Section 19.1, printed p.90 (chosen simplicial tensors); coequalizer-descent construction written explicitly here.
